reviews.review:
The Game is promising but it needs a lot of work.
Would like to give it a "try later"
Pros.
New Take on Invader Plotline
Creative (but too easy) Bosses
Primising Gamepaly

Cons.

Clunky movement
(Would love to see double jump as an upgrade and not as an item.)
Option that camera dont reset the camera on Sprint.

No Koop (YET)

A lot of bugs

No Fetch Quests to unlok stuff would be nice.
Trap Quest is not fun and feels clunky.
Minimap/Map would be good ( I know the maps now but if you play them the firdt time you just run and hope)
Balancing issues either you are so op that evrything dies just by looking at it or you just get utility items and take 10 yyears to kill stuff,
Some Quests wont work with AoE on Kill effects..... you just automaticly fail them. I am Looking at you colour Murker challenge.
Challenge with The Big murkers can lead to freeze for a few seconfd if you kill them all at once with your "On kill" effects so all splitforms die at the same time.
